race.description: Frankston Sand Soil & Mix Colin Alderson Classic Hcp
race.comment: DOUBT TIME (1) just gets the nod in the opener but it will be heart in mouth stuff. He's an ex Nick Ryan horse who transfers to Clinton McDonald off a very good third in the G3 Blue Sapphire when unsuited by the pattern, charging home. He'd have run well in the G1 Coolmore Stud Stakes off that and 1400m looks ideal, albeit he'll be giving VALAROSO (2) a fair head start. VALAROSO is a nice type himself, dominant two back at Seymour then very good in the G3 Red Anchor. The end of 1400m is a niggle but he'll give himself every chance. MONGOLIAN HERO (4) is progressive off a soft maiden win at Pakenham and can measure up. LADHAR (6) is mixing form and can hold fourth ahead of OBAMBULATE (3).
